relevance_note: Cohort of 12 SSADHD probands with ALDH5A1 genotypes and per-patient clinical data in Supplementary Table 2 ("13 ALDH5A1 variants ... were detected in 12 probands"), plus one undiagnosed homozygous c.515G > A carrier.
method_note: Hand extraction; a Python script in the scratch directory assembled the JSON and copied row segments from Supplementary Table 2 (per-patient rows; patients with two variants have two rows, demographics and phenotype taken from the first row, identical in both) and Table 4 (ACMG codes and classification per variant); output checked against the tables. Labels: the paper refers to its 12 probands as 'patient N' (text: 'patient 1', 'Patient 3', 'patients 1 ~ 9'; tables use bare ID numbers), so all are labelled 'patient 1'..'patient 12' (rule 1). An additional person, an undiagnosed patient homozygous for c.515G > A (p.R172H) with normal urinary GHB who died, is in scope (ALDH5A1 variant) as 'unnamed person 1'; not counted in the 12 and not called a proband (is_proband null). Patients 1-9 were previously reported by the authors ([13]); they are described first-hand here, so source_reference_in_review is 'not reported' and the citation is in publications. Left out: the SNPs c.538C>T (p.H180Y) and c.545C>T (p.P182L) found in patients 1 and 5 (classified Benign / Likely Benign, called SNPs; per the dismissed-common-variant rule). Supplementary Table 2 'Variant type' 'Deletion' (c.85_116del, c.398_399del, chr:24403265-24566986del) recorded as 'other' because the authors do not state frameshift/nonsense/large deletion; 'Splicing' -> splice. chr:24403265-24566986del is printed without a build; Methods say the Hg19 reference was used. Transcript NM_001080.3 is from the Methods for ALDH5A1 generally. Inheritance not reported for anyone: Methods say parents were Sanger-sequenced but no per-parent results are given. Functional evidence is from in vitro HeLa expression (text sentences naming each variant); not available for c.1344-2del and the chr deletion, which are also absent from Table 4. Supp. Table 2 'NA' = not available and '-' = loss of follow-up (legend): both treated as not reported. 'No' under Seizure/Communication/Motor developmental delay treated as an explicit negative. 'Other abnormalities: No' (patients 3, 7, 9) excludes nothing specific; not recorded. 'Motor developmental delay: No' (patients 1, 9) does not exclude the broader checklist item 'gross or fine motor deficits'. 'elevated GHB ... in all patients' recorded as an observed group statement for the 12 probands. Patient 3's 'no abnormalities in ... psychiatric status' recorded as written; no specific psychiatric checklist item excluded. Severe hyperactivity disorder (patient 1) mapped to checklist 'attention problems or ADHD'. Contradictions: (1) patient 1 has 'Intellectual disability: Below elementary-school level' in Table 1 and Supp. Table 2, but the text says 'her intelligence was normal' -> both feature rows, checklist intellectual disability 'not reported'; (2) patient 1 'Motor developmental delay: No' (table) vs 'Her motor ability was moderately impaired' (text) - treated as different features; (3) patient 1 seizures '10-year seizure freedom' (table) vs '1 ~ 2 seizures per year' at 15 y (text); (4) c.1529 is written c.1529 C > T in text/Table 1/Supp. Table 2 but c.1529G > A in Table 2 and Supp. Table 1; c.85_116del is c.86-116del in Supp. Table 1; (5) patient 9 text says she 'had yet progressed beyond single-word utterances' (wording ambiguous; not used). Table 1 phenotype cells with several patients are labelled per patient ('1: ...5: ...'), not stacked; no ' / ' stacked cells were used. Deceased persons' ages at death not given (only 'in infancy').
